Name: Farmable Goblins
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[b]Marnie’s been doing a little community outreach with the local goblin population, and now a handful of them are looking for honest work on your farm. They’re surprisingly helpful once they warm up to you — every other day they’ll leave behind Goblin Eggs, and after building enough friendship, they’ll even dig up geodes, ore, and shiny gems for you. [/b]
[b]
“...Wait. Goblins don’t lay eggs...” Don’t ask questions you aren’t prepared to hear the answers to.[/b]
[b]
You can turn Goblin Eggs into jars of Goblin Mayo for profit… or drink the mayo yourself for a temporary speed boost like the unhinged farmer you were always meant to be.[/b]
[b]
All you need to do first is have Robin build them a cozy Goblin Warren to live in and they'll move right on in. Coincidentally they eat hay so no worries there. [/b]

[b]Perfect for all the little witches and wizards out there wanting to spice up their farming experience. [/b]

[b]**If this warms your little goblin heart please consider clicking the endorse button to reach more goblin-minded folks**[/b]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[b]SMAPI[/b]
[b]Content Patcher[/b]
[b]Extra Animal Configs[/b]
[b]Livestock Bazaar[/b]


[b]***special thanks to Hayato2236 for helping me fix my translation files***[/b]

Manifest.Name: Farmable Goblins
Manifest.Description: Adds goblins as farmable animals. Build a Goblin Warren to house them, collect Goblin Eggs to make Goblin Mayonnaise, and let them roam your farm digging up gems and jewels.
Manifest.Author: CozyPsychologist
